history.event: Claude refinement: 62 line(s) suggested — Corrected garbled words in the entry formulas (spese di casa deono an̄e, A di … dapile, soꝓadetto, ꝓ cōto delbestiame, mess luigi, apigliare ilsindachato) and the amounts: lira signs Kraken read as 4, sums in words checked against the column (due ß viij = 2 8, due ß ij = 2 2, quarantuno = 41, dodici ß x = 12 10, 1486). | layout: Page order: the line order is scrambled. l22–l27, l29, l31, l51, l53, l57, l58 and l74–l79 are numbered after the main text but sit higher up the page (sums column, folio number, other leaves).; l9, l47: only the lira sign at the end of the line above sits in the box (l25 and l46). The figures of the sum (2 · 2) are outside every box, except the first 2 (l29, l53).; l11: the sum 2 · 10 at the right is a separate box (l31). l31 should read '2 10' (lire 2, soldi 10), not '210'.; l21, l28: these boxes hold the marginal stroke that marks a new entry, not text. Delete them or leave them empty.; l26: holds only 'att' at the start of the line 'att a 2 ___ ⫳ 2 · 2'. The rest of that line is in no box.; l27, l13: the box takes in struck-through text from a cancelled line (about 'premio dartinni …') below the written line. That line probably needs its own box marked [del:].; l74: holds only one sign. The '15' after it on the last line is outside any box. It probably belongs to l73.; l75–l79: these sit on the edge of the next leaf or fold (beyond the gutter), not on this page. Delete them, or tag them as not part of this page.; l51, l57: two pieces of one sum (about 'i · ꝉ̃ · ꝓ°') next to l41/l42. They should be one box. | doubts: l1, l24, l68: the image seems to show a final j (Lxxxvij, xiiij°, viij). I kept Kraken's numerals as the rule says. Laura to decide. For l24, xiiij versus xiij is uncertain.; l2: chose 'x' (not xx) because the dates go up through the page: x, xiiij, xx (l14), 21 (l38), 5 and viij maggio.; l3/l4/l13: 'almunaio' (al mugnaio, to the miller) fits the flour entries (l5, l12). How l3 ends (nostro me…) is unclear.; l23, l11, l48, l54, l67: read 'att' as a word, not as struck text (the crossbar is the tt ligature). Meaning unclear (alla tavola?).; l33, l34: the large R-like sign after soꝓadetto and after d is shown as ƒ, following Kraken. It could be a different sign.; l35/l36/l37: 'quarantuno' is confirmed by ⫳ 41 in l37. Whether l36 starts 'e buoi' or '(lire)' is uncertain.; l52/l54: 'pifari della pie|ve di santa maria' is a guess from the formula. The first words of l52 are uncertain.; l69: the word after ⫳ is read as trēta (30), from the sum ⫳ 30 in l72. The letters look like 'ticta'.; l8, l17, l42, l59, l63, l70, l71: left mostly as Kraken read them. I could not read these hard passages with confidence.; l51/l57: could not read the sum (i · ꝉ̃ · ꝓ°?).
